HDMI Pipeline
#############

.. note:: **TL;DR**
   - Guide to the **Linux kernel HDMI display pipeline** — covering DRM/KMS drivers, HDMI transmitters, connector configuration, and integration with **Allwinner, Rockchip, and NXP i.MX** platforms.
   - Covers the display pipeline from SoC display controller through HDMI PHY to output.

For related multimedia documentation, see the `multimedia section <https://wiki.amarulasolutions.com/opensource/thirdparty/multimedia/index.html>`_ and the `MIPI DSI guide <https://wiki.amarulasolutions.com/opensource/thirdparty/multimedia/mipi_dsi.html>`_.

.. tip::
